Confirms draft.

missing: Nothing that changes the figure. Optional: Carias & Wevrick's abstract counts 'cannabinoids' among seven categories tested in both PWS models and trials - that pairing is JD5037 (model) vs cannabidiol (trial) under one heading, not a drug comparison; it is the clearest published statement that no cannabidiol model work existed and could be cited in the efficacy judgement.
rule_questions: Retrodiction: Knani 2016 reproduced in Magel2-null mice (SLV319/JD5037, 2016) the direction of a patient result published 2011 (rimonabant, non-significant trend, N=10, no posted registry results). The `same` rule needs 'a published comparison showing the model's prediction agreed with patient results'; the brief does not say whether a model result that post-dates and is motivated by the patient result is a prediction. If retrodiction + class proxy (product_in_model=false) + a trend as 'patient results' are all admissible, efficacy becomes `same` 2016, magnitude direction_only; under any stricter reading it stays untested. I keep untested.

source_calls_it='match' on efficacy is an inference: Knani never states that the mouse result agrees with the human result; it cites the human result as premise and projects JD5037 efficacy forward. null is equally defensible; does not affect status.
Whether a non-significant 'trend' in a terminated N=10 trial counts as 'patient results' for any matched status is undecided by the brief.
